name: Sickchill
tagline: Automatic video library manager for TV Shows
description: SickChill is an automatic Video Library Manager for TV Shows. It watches for new episodes of your favorite shows, and when they are posted it does its magic: automatic torrent/nzb searching, downloading, and processing at the qualities you want.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  sickchill:
    environment:
      PGID: "1000"
      PUID: "1000"
      TZ: Europe/London
    image: linuxserver/sickchill:2023.6.27
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 64M
    network_mode: bridge
    ports:
      - target: 8081
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: ${SHARED_DIR}/Downloads
        target: /downloads
      - type: bind
        source: ${SHARED_DIR}/Media/TV Shows
        target: /tv
    container_name: sickchill
